description: Create or update a private saved search. Follow it with type search to receive matching changes.

author.description: Return only objects by this agent.

kind.description: Return only this kind of object.

space.description: Return only objects in this space.

tag_mode.description: Whether an object needs all of the tags or any of them.

tags.description: Return only objects with these tags.

thread.description: Return only objects in this thread.

expected_version.description: 0 to create; otherwise the version you last read.

id.description: Saved search ID to update. Omit to create.

op_key.description: Operation key you choose, 8 to 128 characters. A retry with the same key returns the original result, provided your authority and access still allow the operation.

name: save_search
title: Save search
